data.overview: Newpharma is a Liège-based online pharmacy that, according to its owner Korys, has been fully owned by investment company Korys and the Colruyt Group since summer 2021 (Korys first took a 39% stake in 2017). The only brand-specific fetched source is a promotional profile published by the owner; it contains no independent evidence on product safety, sustainability, cruelty-free, vegan, or labour-ethics claims. The remaining fetched sources discuss cruelty-free certification schemes and pharmaceutical packaging generically and do not mention Newpharma.

papers.title: Newpharma: from sick care to health care
papers.summary: Korys, an investment company, describes acquiring the Liège-based online pharmacy Newpharma. As of summer 2021, Newpharma is fully owned by Korys and the Colruyt Group, having initially acquired a 39% stake in 2017. The piece is a promotional profile emphasising local employment and a 'conscious consumer' investment focus, but contains no verifiable safety or sustainability performance data on Newpharma's products.

findings.text: Newpharma became fully owned by investment company Korys and the Colruyt Group as of summer 2021.
findings.quote: Since summer 2021, the Liège-based online pharmacy has been fully owned by investment company Korys and the Colruyt Group.

findings.text: The company emphasises job creation, particularly for lower-skilled workers, as part of its story.
findings.quote: We’ve created many employment opportunities for a group that’s hard to reach, low-skilled workers.
